syllabusSource.title: PDEU course handout 2024-25 (CHEM semester 1): Engineering Chemistry Laboratory
syllabusSource.note: Units and topics copied from the course handout PDF (pages 7 of CHEM/sem1/Chemical_Semester_1_Course_Handout.pdf). New in Prism: no curated sources or checked lessons yet.

topics.name: Iodometry
topics.aim: to determine the strength of a given copper sulphate solution by titrating against N/20 sodium thiosulphate (hypo) solution.

topics.name: Iodimetry
topics.aim: to determine the strength of given ascorbic acid by titrating against standard N/10 iodine solution.

topics.name: Complexometric titration
topics.aim: to determine the total, permanent and temporary hardness of given water using standard 0.01 M EDTA solution.

topics.name: pH-metric titration
topics.aim: to determine the strength of a given HCl solution using a standard NaOH solution.

topics.name: Conductometric titration
topics.aim: to determine the strength of a given HCl solution using a standard NaOH solution.

topics.name: Chemical kinetics
topics.aim: to study the kinetics of decomposition of sodium thiosulphate by a mineral acid.

topics.name: Drawing chemical structures
topics.aim: to draw chemical structures of organic molecules using ChemDraw.

topics.name: Colorimetric determination
topics.aim: to determine the concentration of copper present in the effluent of electroplating industries using a colorimeter.

topics.name: Preparation of a drug molecule: preparation of aspirin from salicylic acid.
Polymerization
topics.aim: to prepare a polymer (Nylon 6,10) and identify the functional groups by FT-IR. Max 26 Hrs
